name: Engagement letter: advisory and outsourced CFO services

blocks.text: {Firm name} (“firm,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is pleased to provide {Client name} (“you” or “your”) with the advisory services described below for {Agreement year}. Please read this letter, the Terms and Conditions below and any other attachments incorporated herein (collectively, “Agreement”).
We will act as your outside financial advisor. Our services include:

items: regular meetings with you to review your financial results, cash flow and key measures;
help preparing budgets, forecasts and cash flow projections from the assumptions you approve;
advice on financial processes, controls and reporting; and
answering your questions on business finance as they arise, within a reasonable time each month.

blocks.text: These services are consulting services under the AICPA’s Statement on Standards for Consulting Services. They are non-attest services: we will not audit, review or compile financial statements or express any assurance on them. Projections and forecasts depend on your assumptions and on future events; actual results will differ, and we do not guarantee them.

We will not make management decisions or perform management functions on your behalf, hold custody of your assets, or authorize or execute transactions. You are responsible for all decisions, for designating a person with suitable skill, knowledge and experience to oversee our services, for evaluating the adequacy and results of our services, and for the accuracy and completeness of the information you provide.
Our fees for the services in this Agreement are:

A monthly fee is charged each month to the payment method you set up on our client portal, until this Agreement ends. Projects outside the services above, such as a business valuation, a financing package or a tax return, are agreed and billed separately.

This Agreement covers the services for {Agreement year} and continues month to month after that until replaced by a new agreement or ended by either party in writing, as the Terms and Conditions describe.

We appreciate the opportunity to be of service to you. This Agreement, including the Terms and Conditions, represents the entire agreement of the parties relating to the services that are the subject of this Agreement. Please sign below to accept it.
